data.name: Catharine
data.gender_notes: Catharine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Aikaterina, meaning 'pure' or 'clean'. Catharine was a popular name among early Christians, often associated with saints and martyrs. In the New Testament, Saint Catherine of Alexandria is the most famous bearer of this name, known for her faith and miraculous healing. The name Catharine carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Catharine usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity, cleansing, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Catharine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Catharine total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: קתרין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קתרין מקורו במילה היוונית 'קתרוס', שפירושה טהור ונקי. השם משויך לניקיון ולטוהר, ומהווה סמל לנשים שומרות על ערכי טוהר וצניעות. השם מופיע במסורות הנוצריות והקתוליות כאחד.

in_greek.name: Καθερίνη
in_greek.meaning: Καθαρή και αγνή, ελευθερία και φως
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καθερίνη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'καθαρρός', που σημαίνει καθαρός και αγνός. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της ελευθερίας και του φωτός, και αποτελεί σύμβολο για τις γυναίκες που επιθυμούν να κρατήσουν αξίες όπως η αγνότητα και η καθαρότητα. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Καθερίνη σχετίζεται με την αγία Αικατερίνη της Αλεξανδρείας.

in_latin.name: Catharina
in_latin.meaning: Pure and clear, free from sin
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Catharina originates from the Greek word 'katharos', meaning pure and clean. In Christian tradition, the name symbolizes a person's commitment to purity and spiritual cleanliness. The name was popularized by Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a 4th-century martyr and philosopher.

in_english.name: Catharine
in_english.meaning: Pure, clear, and clean, a symbol of spiritual purity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Catharine is derived from the Greek word 'katharos', meaning pure and clean. The name has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person's commitment to spiritual purity and cleanliness. Historically, the name has been associated with Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a 4th-century martyr and philosopher. The name Catharine has been popular across various Christian cultures, symbolizing virtues such as modesty, humility, and spiritual devotion.

data.cultural_impact: Catharine was a popular given name up until the Middle Ages, particularly in Europe. The name has since been adopted in various cultures and languages, including Katerina (Greek), Katharina (German), Catherine (English), and Caterina (Italian). The name is also known to have been borne by several European monarchs and noblewomen.
data.spiritual_significance: Catharine, derived from the Greek 'Aikaterina,' meaning pure or clean, was a name deeply rooted in the traditions of the early Christian church. With the name's association with saints and martyrs, it became a symbol of devotion and faith, inspiring many who bore the name to live in accordance with Christian values throughout history. In particular, Saint Catherine of Alexandria, who was subjected to various forms of torture for her faith, is revered as a patron saint of scholars and unmarried women. Through the lives of these holy women, the name Catharine remains a reminder of the strength and purity of the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Catharine is derived from the Greek word "katharos," meaning pure. In Christianity, Catherine represents the pure and virtuous soul, striving for spiritual enlightenment and cleansing. Her symbol is a wheel, symbolizing the cycle of life, transformation, and God's eternal presence.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Catharine remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life.
